description: This PHP source file defines a migration class for upgrading the database schema and configuration of the OrangeHRM system to version 4.1. It contains methods for modifying database columns and setting configuration values.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A migration class that updates database schema and configuration settings for OrangeHRM version 4.1.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs database schema changes and updates configuration values required for the migration to version 4.1.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version number of the migration ('4.1').
